basis: The student maintains an attendance of 68%, which falls within the allowable condonation limit of up to 65% for representing the university.
The attendance is below 65%, which does not qualify for condonation and incurs an 'R' grade under the regulations.
The base rule and attendance policy explicitly permit students with attendance equal to or above 65% and less than 75% to take the semester-end examination under a grade cap.
